source.surface: restore-to-earlier-version confirmation, enumerating the work that will be destroyed
source.attribution: Screen curated by Mobbin (https://mobbin.com). Inspected remotely through the Mobbin MCP under accessMode 'remote-mcp'. No image was downloaded, cached, embedded, or stored anywhere in this repository; every value below is our own reading of the rendered screen.

evidenceTier.rationale: Mobbin is a curated gallery of captured screens. It is not a live observation we made of a running product, and no audience outcome is attached, so it cannot be silver/M2 or gold/M3. Treat these facts as evidence that a shipped product once looked this way, not as evidence that it worked.

decisionColour.acceptControlTreatment: solid red fill with a white label — the destructive hue is on the committing control, not on the content it will destroy
decisionColour.rejectControlTreatment: Cancel, unfilled label text immediately to its left
decisionColour.undecidedContainerTreatment: the two rows enumerating the work that will be lost sit on plain white with no red tint; the warning colour is used once, on the glyph beside the title, and once on the button
decisionColour.verdict: Decision colour confined to the button. Notably the hue chosen is red rather than the product's primary, so the commit control announces the direction of the consequence without tinting the content at risk.
